decisions.pricing: Per property per month add-on on top of Pro; amount TBD (configurable in src/config/plans.ts, set before launch)
decisions.people: Workers and vendors both get accounts via manager invite: manager enters name + email/phone, worker gets invite link, sets password, completes profile (skills; vendors: company + insurance/COI expiry). After onboarding they receive per-job links and codes
decisions.codes: All three: property access codes shown only during the job window; job QR at the property for on-site check-in/out; one-time login/verification codes by email
decisions.scope: Everything in the G7 outline for v1: work orders (from guest reports + manual), lifecycle with actor/timestamp audit, field PWA /maint, photos, checklists with required photos + review queue, vendor directory with COI expiry, time tracking + pay export, preventive schedules, live board + overdue/unassigned alerts
decisions.offline: Read offline + queued status/photo updates (service-worker approach like the tablet)
decisions.notifications: Email + web push from the installed PWA (no SMS in v1)
decisions.assign_approve: Only the property manager (company admins) creates, assigns, approves and verifies work
decisions.cost_approval: Yes: estimate over company threshold (default $250) waits for manager approval
decisions.branding: Managing company name/logo, Powered by StayGuide
